comment.body:
Thanks to everyone who has already supplied diagnostic logs; we are not asking you to upload another archive. This thread includes both Keyboard Manager startup failures and a separate AltGr-associated engine crash, so it is not yet clear which behavior is still current.

If you are still affected, please reply with the PowerToys version and say whether Keyboard Manager fails to start or instead crashes after a keyboard action. For the AltGr case, include the keyboard layout and the exact AltGr/key sequence immediately before the crash. This will let maintainers scope one current reproduction and avoid conflating the two symptoms.
